chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 573: Han Li’s Ruthless Purge and a Gift from Yuan Yao
chapter_meta_description: Han Li turns the tables on his demonic captors with a brutal sword display. After a bloody purge, he reunites with the sharp-witted Yuan Yao, who gifts him the priceless Ten-Thousand-Year Spirit Liquid.
og_title: A Calculated Massacre and a Free Gift – RMJI Chapter 573
og_description: Han Li reveals his true strength, butchering two Core Formation foes. Then, over tea, an old acquaintance offers him a priceless treasure for free. Why?
twitter_title: Han Li’s Bloody Revenge & the Price of a Gift – Chapter 573
twitter_description: Han Li stops pretending and unleashes hell on his captors. After the bloody dust settles, a clever ally presents him with a strategic gift that’s worth more than gold.

lore_anchors.definition: A Chinese idiom for something that is "tasteless to discard, but a pity to keep"; in xianxia, it describes a powerful treasure that cannot be used.
An advanced sword art that allows a single flying sword to split into multiple identical phantoms, massively increasing firepower.
An extremely rare and potent condensed form of natural energy that can instantly replenish a cultivator’s mana; a life-saving trump card.
The number one secret treasure of the Chaos Star Sea, currently in Han Li’s possession but impossible for him to use.
